purpose: Teach: リュック/コスメ/さんま/琵琶湖/ライトアップ/待ち遠しい/リベンジ/新居

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、登山リュック、背負って、よく出かけた。
lines.en: In my younger days, I'd sling on my hiking pack and head out all the time.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Unhurried pace. Gazes into middle distance. A gentle smile in the voice—not loud, but present.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。当時、コスメ、シンプルだったわね。
lines.en: Yes, you know, things were simpler back then. Even cosmetics.
lines.style: Warm agreement. A small, knowing laugh underneath. Tender but matter-of-fact. Settles into the memory comfortably.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 秋のさんま、焼き魚、母が得意だった。
lines.en: My mother was wonderful at grilling sanma in the fall. Always so delicious.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude threading through. Slight pause before the memory fully lands. Voice softens on the details. Almost speaking to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 新婚旅行、琵琶湖、二人で行ったわね。
lines.en: Our honeymoon to Lake Biwa—we went together, just the two of us.
lines.style: Gentle, intimate recall. Each phrase is deliberate, unhurried. Warmth that's unmissable but never performed. Slight trailing-off at the end, lingering in the feeling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 夜のお寺、ライトアップ、最近、流行り。
lines.en: These days, temples all lit up at night have become quite fashionable, haven't they?
lines.style: Observational and gentle. A hint of amusement at how things change. Measured pace. The tone of someone noticing the world shift around him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫の七五三、待ち遠しいわ。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to our grandchild's Shichigosan celebration.
lines.style: Soft anticipation. A subtle brightness lifts the tone. Genuine warmth without any strain. Small pause on the feeling of waiting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 去年逃したお花見、来年リベンジしよう。
lines.en: I missed the cherry blossoms last year. Let's make sure we see them together next spring.
lines.style: Light determination mixed with affection. A touch more energy than before—this is a gentle promise. Steady eye-contact quality in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 息子の新居、可愛いリビング、覚えてる?
lines.en: Do you remember how lovely the living room was in our son's new place?
lines.style: Warm, inviting question. Voice full of shared delight. Leans toward her—seeking that moment of recognition together. Genuine curiosity underneath.
